findings: Latency-based automatic ejection and periodic health probes falsely attributed to DestinationRule; obsolete consecutiveErrors and unsupported enforcing fields.

Released Istio1.31 applyOutlierDetection sets max_ejection_percent only for values>0; corrected false0%=observation advice. The same function disables success-rate enforcement.

summary: Enabled real path/tier descriptor generation, bounded fallback and egress scoping; repaired global Redis/gRPC prerequisites and commit-image pinning, metrics, dashboard and diagnostics.
findings: Path/tier descriptors lack route actions, fallback bucket and enabled/enforced fractions; tier groups are not per-user buckets and caller headers are untrusted.
Global rate-limit Deployment has no Redis backend/REDIS_SOCKET_TYPE/REDIS_URL wiring and labels an old commit tag stable; global failure semantics and actual quota guarantees missing.
Global action EnvoyFilter in default cannot select ingressgateway in istio-system; vhost names guessed; additive global action examples can overwrite or duplicate policy.
Hand-added plaintext cluster bypasses Istio service/mTLS handling; use generated gRPC service cluster with explicit deployment assumptions.
Outbound limiter affects all HTTP destinations and is disabled without fractions; HTTPS opaque traffic is not HTTP-rate-limited.
Burst tokens confused with sustained req/s; global over_limit described as call count; local rate_limited differs from enforced; absent metrics prefixes and malformed/incomplete dashboard.
Redis CLI assumed present in rate-limit image; IPv4-name-filtered diagnostic misses listeners; default logs do not enumerate all limiter decisions.
Used LocalRateLimit.rate_limits descriptor generation verified in the exact Envoy protobuf revision pinned by Istio1.31; avoids guessed route names for local path/tier limits.

Pinned published commit8fe6ea42 and manifest sha256:a61547259607d40aff153050c2a87873ca1676d1d9f5f06937d412000dcc2df1; Docker Hub confirms linux/amd64 and linux/arm64. Upstream has no semantic versioning after oldv1.4.0; not labeled a certified stable release.

Global Deployment explicitly requires existing Redis and actual sidecar/gRPC policy connectivity; no complete HA/production claim. The retained cache diagram is explained as a shared counter store, not independent in-process caches.
